name: Pass it here
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE finished desktop website hero screenshot, landscape 1536x1024, for Perry, a tiny hand-drawn computer companion. This must be a singular designed encounter, not a conventional SaaS hero. The previous designs failed because they pasted an app screenshot under a big sales headline. NO app screenshots, UI cards, split columns, feature grid, paper book, curling page, desk objects, notebook rules, fake trust signals.
CREATIVE IDEA: the visitor is about to hand their cursor to Perry. The cursor is the hero object. A miniature ink character and a monumental computer pointer meet at radically different scales. Every visual element must serve this one encounter.
Art direction: ultra-clean milk-white canvas, intense black lithographic ink, a SINGLE vibrant vermilion accent. Graphic confidence of an experimental typography exhibition, inviting character acting, beautifully crafted paper/ink microtexture visible only close up. Mature and playful, sunny and energetic, never sepia, melancholy or chalkboard. Hard precise layout mixed with alive hand-drawn marks.
Composition: tiny hand-lettered lowercase 'perry' at x80 y60. Small understated top-right navigation 'The idea' and 'Get Perry ↗', no large top button. The top 75 percent of the viewport is ONE astonishing integrated type/illustration composition, not columns. A monumental matte-black computer cursor arrow, diagonally tilted, about 850px tall, occupies center-left; its pointed tip aims toward upper-left. It is a real instantly recognisable arrow silhouette with impeccable shape, slightly dry screenprint edges, subtle pressure variation, FLAT INK not 3D plastic. Across and behind the arrow, ENORMOUS fluid custom handwritten lowercase 'go on.' extends nearly edge to edge, its black letters switching to warm white ONLY where they cross the black cursor. This is exact figure-ground inversion, not shadows. Beautiful bold energetic brush script, highly readable, exquisite connected lettering, typography and cursor interlock like a brilliant graphic identity.
At lower-right corner of the large cursor, a tiny Perry (130px tall, big round UNFILLED head, TWO small vertical oval eyes, NO mouth, minimalist ink stick limbs) braces one foot against the arrow tail and reaches his hand toward a SMALL normal-sized vermilion visitor cursor. His posture is open, eager, funny, as if saying 'pass it here'. Exactly one tiny handwritten annotation beside him: 'I’ve got it.' The only small vermilion cursor sits just outside his reaching hand, with a thin hand-drawn vermilion circular target around the exchange point. This meeting is the second focal point after the giant graphic.
Bottom 20 percent is pristine white, aligned on a single editorial baseline: at left a 30px clean sans product promise 'An extra pair of hands for your Mac.' Under it 18px copy 'Perry can see your screen, show you how, and take on the task.' At right a clear VERMILION interaction button with black text exactly 'Hand it to Perry ↗', and discreet functional line beneath 'Try it here. No installation.' No second sales pitch. A small sun/moon theme icon beside the navigation. All text has ample clear space and all controls stay readable. The invitation should feel irresistible because it is an actual handoff encounter. The line of sight between character and small cursor, positive body language, extreme scale contrast and typographic inversion must be exact. No poster mockup edges, no outer frame, no decorative sparkles. Output polished actual homepage design, not a moodboard.

name: Take the shortcut
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE extraordinary finished website hero for Perry, an ink stick-figure companion that helps operate your Mac. 1536x1024 landscape. This is a second conceptual treatment of meeting a living cursor companion. The website must feel like an ingenious authored experience, no conventional big-copy-left/screenshot-right template, no dashboard, no Finder, no paper diorama or cardstock pop-up.
CONCEPT: THE SHORTCUT THROUGH THE PAGE. The entire hero is a typographic maze which Perry has quietly drawn a shortcut through. The implication is useful computer help: stop hunting through steps. A coherent, elegant graphic device, not a decorative maze unrelated to the message.
Full canvas deep black smooth uncoated paper, with ivory lettering and ONE warm vivid coral accent. Extremely sharp print contrast, lively and confident, not spooky or gloomy. At top-left small handwritten 'perry'; top-right tiny 'Get Perry for Mac ↗' and sun/moon icon. At top center small exact product line 'Your Mac. With someone who knows the way.'
Most of viewport is enormous expressive ivory handwritten lettering arranged as a single continuous beautiful text path: exact words 'there’s an easier way.' This lettering is both readable and architectural. It flows from left-middle through center toward lower-right in broad sweeping curves and dramatic long connected strokes, occupying 75 percent of the image, with some elegant letter flourishes cropped off lateral edges. It must be impeccably custom-lettered, energetic, warm, not a stock cursive font. Within the oversized bowl of the word 'easier', the ivory ink outline becomes the frame of a tiny simple black doorway, where a MINIATURE Perry figure steps across a CORAL ink bridge that runs in one straight confident diagonal across the otherwise winding letter paths. Perry is 120px tall with ivory outline circular head, exactly TWO vertical eyes, NO mouth, spare stick limbs; he carries a SMALL conventional ivory cursor arrow under one arm, friendly purposeful walk. The coral path originates at a small thin coral ring lower-left labelled in small native sans 'You are here', then passes UNDER one letter stroke, OVER the next, and arrives at Perry near center-right. Make all occlusions optically precise so the shortcut genuinely cuts through the lettering. Only one route line, one character, one cursor. No arrows everywhere, no icons or app logos, no multiple cartoon scenes.
Bottom strip generous black negative space: left 24px ivory sans text 'Ask for help. Learn the steps. Hand it over.' Right ONE warm ivory filled action 'Take the shortcut ↗' with black text, beside restrained secondary text 'A website demo'. Directly under the product line or bottom copy, small readable clarification 'Perry sees your screen and helps you get things done.' The brand impression should be intimate, audacious, welcoming and exquisitely typeset; strong graphic identity and an understandable invitation into a useful product demonstration. Fine ink texture only in artwork, no heavy grain behind text. NO gradients, neon, stars, windows, feature cards, hand-drawn arrows used as generic decoration, 3D object, hardware frame, collage presentation, fake metrics, slogans in every corner. The sophistication comes from lettering, intentional empty space and the single unexpected passage through it.
